title: Unified Engram↔TermAl identifier and process contract: one producer-owned wire spec, reused validators, cross-project conformance tests
outcome: Unified Engram↔TermAl identifier and process contract: one producer-owned wire spec, reused validators, cross-project conformance tests
acceptance: A design note, concurred by Termal::Architect2 and Engram::Architect3, inventories every identifier and fingerprint crossing the Engram–TermAl boundary (producer, semantic kind, accepted forms, every validator on each side) and names one owner validator per kind on each side

The design states the producer-owned wire specification to be reused (no new runtime handshake, manual manifest or extra approval gate) and lists the concrete duplicate or divergent validators to retire, each as a linked implementation item

The design specifies producer/consumer conformance tests in the existing suites of both repositories, covering ordinary and recovery paths and project and host scope, each as a linked implementation item
disposal_reason: Filed concurrently with Architect2's choice. Termal::Architect2 and Engram::Architect3 consolidated the joint Engram–TermAl identifier/process contract onto existing TermAl w-a08b0320448f (FINAL joint plan note there, 16:47Z) and Engram w-d7826c4f78ec; this duplicate is superseded to avoid a parallel record.
